verdict_reason: Deleting the page spec matches the ticket, but no test anywhere proves the acceptance criterion that the old URL no longer serves the page.

todos.issue: The page spec is deleted, which is right. But the acceptance criterion 'The old contact address URL no longer serves the page' has no test anywhere in the PR set. A grep for 'consignment/contact' and 'contact/select' across the ins-tests and animals-frontend review clones, and across the live-animals coverage, finds nothing. If the route were registered again, nothing would turn red.
todos.fix: Must: one test opens the old contact address URL for a draft and asserts the exact response the service now gives (for example the 404 page heading). One way: add an e2e test to tests/animals/e2e/journeys that opens /consignment/contact/select for a seeded draft and asserts the not-found heading, or a frontend route test that does the same, and link it from the journey-flow or contact-address spec.
